brief.situation_en: Maria shops with her friend Aino.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text_puhe: Kumpi on parempi, sininen vai musta?

lines.gloss_en: Which is better, the blue or the black?

lines.speaker: Aino
lines.text_puhe: Sininen! Se sopii sulle tosi hyvin.
lines.text_kirja: Sininen! Se sopii sinulle todella hyvin.
lines.gloss_en: The blue! It really suits you.

judge.reason: sulle/sinulle and tosi/todella are register differences only; same meaning.

lines.speaker: Maria
